diff --git a/tests/test_utils.py b/tests/test_utils.py
--- a/tests/test_utils.py
+++ b/tests/test_utils.py
@@ -529,6 +529,7 @@
         ('Camel2Snake', 'camel_2_snake'),
         ('_CamelToSnake', '_camel_to_snake'),
         ('CamelToSnake_', 'camel_to_snake_'),
+        ('CAMELToSnake', 'camel_to_snake'),
         ('__CamelToSnake__', '__camel_to_snake__'),
         ('Camel2', 'camel_2'),
         ('Camel2_', 'camel_2_'),
@@ -540,6 +541,17 @@
 )
 def test_camel2snake(value: str, result: str) -> None:
     assert to_snake(value) == result
+    if value == 'CAMELToSnake':
+        # an acronym followed by a capitalized word is split wherever it appears, not only at the start
+        assert to_snake('HTTPResponse') == 'http_response'
+        assert to_snake('getHTTPResponseCode') == 'get_http_response_code'
+        assert to_snake('userIDToken') == 'user_id_token'
+        assert to_snake('XMLToJSONConverter') == 'xml_to_json_converter'
+        # ... also next to underscores and digits, which are handled as for the other inputs
+        assert to_snake('__HTTPResponse__') == '__http_response__'
+        assert to_snake('base64URLEncode') == 'base_64_url_encode'
+        # a trailing acronym stays one word
+        assert to_snake('parseURL') == 'parse_url'
 
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(
reason: S1/T2c (v1 section4 step2/4): the original F2P asserts one leading 5-letter acronym, the same input shape as the issue example; partial fixes that only split a leading acronym, only the first acronym, or only 3+ letter acronyms score 1. R-c inside the single F2P test body (IDs unchanged): the issue example itself plus non-leading, two-letter and repeated acronyms (v1), plus an acronym next to underscores ('__HTTPResponse__'), an acronym next to digits whose splits both digit readings share ('base64URLEncode', same convention as P2P camel2Snake/Camel2Snake) and a trailing acronym ('parseURL', base behaviour kept by gold) (v2 = v1 + 3 lines, added after skip_if_underscore / lower_or_start_la / skip_if_digit / no_trailing_upper passed v1). No uppercase-letter->digit assertion: base splits (A1 -> a_1), gold and upstream >= 2.8.1 do not (a1); both readings defensible. No single-letter acronym assertion (XAxis, OAuth).
positive_control: gold (golden_patch sha256:290e40116e89b175013661f98a8bbcc1c1bf428e34417d93bc5f0d90fb3835d7); reasonable alternatives keep_digit (base digit rule), upstream_main (upstream 2.8.2+ body), lookaround, scan, normalize
